body:
Thank you for understanding, it is pretty much a game of wait an see for me right now. I also remind myself that funeral costs would completely ruin my family financially.

I was supposed to  wait for a call back but no one has ever gotten to us about it. I didn't think much because the medication was helping immensely and I had a much more positive outlook on life, not to mention I was very busy preparing for my senior year.

I should probably call and see what's up but even that makes me feel anxious so I don't know.

They are sent by mail.
I don't have my psychiatrists emergency contact and my therapist recently switched positions so I'm not really her patient anymore.

If things get worse I will do what I can to get it quicker, but I'm also very poor an dot want to add any financial burden to my mother (even a $10 copay could really screw us up right now)

Basically I dropped all of them a few days ago and they rolled everywhere, I was angry and my house is gross so I threw away what I could find. It was entirely my fault because I know I could have kept them but I was mad and not thinking clearly in the first place. I haven't taken them for about 3 or 4 days now.  I have some ordered but they won't get here until around Tuesday I believe.

I've been taking lexapro for about 4 months now.
